# Crewship

> Crewship sets up cloud hosts for coding agents with Ansible, omp, and Firstmate.

crewship.si publishes the repository guides as readable HTML, alongside a walkable text harbor.
The documentation is rebuilt from the repository README, SETUP guide, and docs directory.
The pages below are the published documentation on the project domain.

## Start here

- [Documentation index](https://crewship.si/docs): All published guides.
- [Overview](https://crewship.si/docs/readme): Features, quick start, and repository layout.
- [Setup](https://crewship.si/docs/setup): Installation and first host setup.
- [Feature index](https://crewship.si/docs/features): Guides for core and optional features.

## Host and agents

- [Architecture](https://crewship.si/docs/architecture): Host components and agent supervision.
- [Configuration](https://crewship.si/docs/configuration): Host settings and optional profiles.
- [omp](https://crewship.si/docs/omp): Sign-in, model roles, and agent skills.
- [Security](https://crewship.si/docs/security): Access controls and host security.
- [Migration and recovery](https://crewship.si/docs/recovery): Updates, migration, and recovery procedures.

## Project

- [Contributing](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development checks and contribution rules.
- [Harbor](https://github.com/i098/Crewship/blob/main/site/README.md): The walkable world, documentation signs, build, and deployment.
